info.name: RideX Backend
info.description:
RideX API. One folder per module, added as each module is built.

Auth: log in (or verify) and the test script stores {{accessToken}} automatically. Requests inherit Bearer {{accessToken}} unless marked No Auth.
Phone numbers accept 01XXXXXXXXX or +8801XXXXXXXXX. With SMS_PROVIDER=console the OTP is printed in the backend terminal.

item.name: Conversations
item.description:
**Socket.io** runs on the API origin ({{baseUrl}}). Connect with `io(baseUrl, { auth: { token } })` using POST /auth/socket-token. Every user joins their own room; the server only emits to rooms.

Client → server
- `message:send` `{ conversationId, body?, quickReplyKey?, clientId? }` ack → `{ success, statusCode, data | message }`
- `typing:start` / `typing:stop` `{ conversationId }` (throttled to one per 2s)
- `conversation:read` `{ conversationId }` ack → `{ success, data }`

Server → client
- `message:new` `{ conversation, message }`: `conversation` is the recipient's own view (unreadCount, side, counterpart)
- `conversation:read` `{ conversationId, readerId, readAt }`: messages with createdAt ≤ readAt are seen
- `typing` `{ conversationId, userId, isTyping }`
- `chat:unread` `{ total, conversations }`
- `block:changed` `{ userId, blockedByMe? | blockedMe? }`
- `notification:new` (notification row) · `notification:unread` `{ total }`
- `auth:error` `{ message }`, sent before the server disconnects a socket whose user was blocked or signed out

Chat is limited to BUYER, SELLER, DEALER, DEALER_STAFF and INSPECTOR. Sending (socket + REST) is limited by CHAT_MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT per minute; new conversations by CHAT_NEW_CONVERSATION_LIMIT per hour. `clientId` (uuid) makes a retried send idempotent.

request.description: Chat roles. One thread per buyer per listing: 201 when created, 200 when the existing thread is reused (the message is added to it). Needs `body` or a buyer `quickReplyKey`. New threads only for APPROVED listings, never your own, never when either side has blocked the other.
Chat roles. Filters: `side=buying|selling` (default both), `archived=true`, `unread=true`, `searchTerm` (listing title or the other person's name). Sorted by last message. Page meta.
Chat roles. `{ total, conversations }` for badges.

Participants only. Cursor pagination: oldest first in `data`; pass `before={{meta.nextCursor}}` for older messages. `meta: { limit, hasMore, nextCursor }` (max limit 50).

item.name: Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications are pushed live over Socket.io (`notification:new`, `notification:unread`). Email copies are queued (BullMQ) and respect preferences. Categories: MESSAGES (unread-message email digest, sent CHAT_EMAIL_DELAY_MINUTES after a message if still unread and the user is offline), LISTINGS, PRICE_ALERTS, REVIEWS, ACCOUNT (always on).
